credit_ledger_entry_shape.name: credit_ledger_entry_shape
credit_ledger_entry_shape.value: ("credit_ledger"."entry_type" = 'grant' AND "credit_ledger"."amount" > 0 AND "credit_ledger"."idempotency_key" IS NOT NULL AND "credit_ledger"."session_event_id" IS NULL AND "credit_ledger"."action_id" IS NULL AND "credit_ledger"."currency" IS NULL) OR ("credit_ledger"."entry_type" = 'model_charge' AND "credit_ledger"."amount" < 0 AND "credit_ledger"."session_event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "credit_ledger"."session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "credit_ledger"."model_id" IS NOT NULL AND "credit_ledger"."input_tokens" IS NOT NULL AND "credit_ledger"."output_tokens" IS NOT NULL AND "credit_ledger"."action_id" IS NULL AND "credit_ledger"."currency" IS NULL) OR ("credit_ledger"."entry_type" = 'action_charge' AND "credit_ledger"."amount" < 0 AND "credit_ledger"."action_id" IS NOT NULL AND "credit_ledger"."pricing_version" IS NOT NULL AND "credit_ledger"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$' AND "credit_ledger"."session_event_id" IS NULL)

intents_constraints_require_criteria.name: intents_constraints_require_criteria
intents_constraints_require_criteria.value: "intents"."constraints" IS NULL OR "intents"."acceptance_criteria" IS NOT NULL

objects_supersession_consistency.name: objects_supersession_consistency
objects_supersession_consistency.value: ("objects"."status" = 'active' AND "objects"."superseded_by" IS NULL AND "objects"."superseded_at" IS NULL) OR ("objects"."status" = 'superseded' AND "objects"."superseded_by" IS NOT NULL AND "objects"."superseded_at" IS NOT NULL)

objects_artifact_blob_consistency.name: objects_artifact_blob_consistency
objects_artifact_blob_consistency.value: ("objects"."type" = 'artifact' AND "objects"."blob_key" IS NOT NULL AND "objects"."blob_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "objects"."blob_content_type" IS NOT NULL AND "objects"."blob_byte_size" IS NOT NULL AND "objects"."blob_byte_size" > 0 AND "objects"."blob_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND position("objects"."brand_id"::text in "objects"."blob_key") > 0 AND position("objects"."blob_sha256" in "objects"."blob_key") > 0) OR ("objects"."type" <> 'artifact' AND "objects"."blob_key" IS NULL AND "objects"."blob_sha256" IS NULL AND "objects"."blob_content_type" IS NULL AND "objects"."blob_byte_size" IS NULL)

schedules_calendar_shape.name: schedules_calendar_shape
schedules_calendar_shape.value: ("schedules"."cadence" IS NULL AND "schedules"."local_time" IS NULL AND "schedules"."local_weekday" IS NULL) OR ("schedules"."cadence" = 'daily' AND "schedules"."local_time" IS NOT NULL AND "schedules"."local_weekday" IS NULL) OR ("schedules"."cadence" = 'weekly' AND "schedules"."local_time" IS NOT NULL AND "schedules"."local_weekday" BETWEEN 0 AND 6)

schedules_enabled_configuration.name: schedules_enabled_configuration
schedules_enabled_configuration.value: NOT "schedules"."enabled" OR ("schedules"."cadence" IS NOT NULL AND "schedules"."local_time" IS NOT NULL AND "schedules"."time_zone" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("schedules"."time_zone")) > 0 AND "schedules"."next_scheduled_for" IS NOT NULL)

session_events_lineage_consistency.name: session_events_lineage_consistency
session_events_lineage_consistency.value: ("session_events"."parent_session_id" IS NULL AND "session_events"."parent_call_id" IS NULL AND "session_events"."root_session_id" = "session_events"."session_id") OR ("session_events"."parent_session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "session_events"."parent_call_id" IS NOT NULL)

tasks_active_commitment_conflict_unique.name: tasks_active_commitment_conflict_unique
tasks_active_commitment_conflict_unique.where: "tasks"."activation" = 'human' AND "tasks"."status" IN ('queued', 'running') AND "tasks"."commitment_conflict_key" IS NOT NULL

tasks_status_mode_valid.name: tasks_status_mode_valid
tasks_status_mode_valid.value: ("tasks"."execution_mode" = 'agent' AND "tasks"."status" IN ('queued', 'running', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'superseded')) OR ("tasks"."execution_mode" = 'direct' AND "tasks"."activation" = 'automatic' AND "tasks"."status" IN ('queued', 'running', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled')) OR ("tasks"."execution_mode" = 'direct' AND "tasks"."activation" = 'human' AND "tasks"."status" IN ('awaiting_approval', 'queued', 'running', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'outcome_unknown', 'expired', 'needs_regeneration', 'dismissed', 'superseded'))

tasks_finished_at_status_consistency.name: tasks_finished_at_status_consistency
tasks_finished_at_status_consistency.value: ("tasks"."status" IN ('awaiting_approval', 'queued', 'running') AND "tasks"."finished_at" IS NULL) OR ("tasks"."status" NOT IN ('awaiting_approval', 'queued', 'running') AND "tasks"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL)

tasks_started_at_status_consistency.name: tasks_started_at_status_consistency
tasks_started_at_status_consistency.value: ("tasks"."status" = 'running' AND "tasks"."started_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("tasks"."status" IN ('awaiting_approval', 'queued') AND "tasks"."started_at" IS NULL) OR "tasks"."status" NOT IN ('awaiting_approval', 'queued', 'running')

tasks_direct_runtime_fields.name: tasks_direct_runtime_fields
tasks_direct_runtime_fields.value: "tasks"."execution_mode" <> 'direct' OR ("tasks"."session_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."completion" IS NULL)

tasks_human_runtime_fields.name: tasks_human_runtime_fields
tasks_human_runtime_fields.value: "tasks"."activation" <> 'human' OR ("tasks"."attempts" = 0 AND "tasks"."leased_until" IS NULL AND "tasks"."session_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."completion" IS NULL AND "tasks"."next_due_at" IS NULL AND "tasks"."next_payload" IS NULL AND "tasks"."next_rationale" IS NULL)

tasks_completion_status_consistency.name: tasks_completion_status_consistency
tasks_completion_status_consistency.value: "tasks"."execution_mode" <> 'agent' OR ("tasks"."status" = 'succeeded' AND "tasks"."completion" IS NOT NULL) OR ("tasks"."status" = 'running') OR ("tasks"."status" IN ('queued', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'superseded') AND "tasks"."completion" IS NULL)

tasks_next_tuple_consistency.name: tasks_next_tuple_consistency
tasks_next_tuple_consistency.value: num_nonnulls("tasks"."next_due_at", "tasks"."next_payload", "tasks"."next_rationale") IN (0, 3) AND ("tasks"."next_due_at" IS NULL OR ("tasks"."status" = 'running' AND jsonb_typeof("tasks"."next_payload") = 'object'))

tasks_intent_snapshot_pair.name: tasks_intent_snapshot_pair
tasks_intent_snapshot_pair.value: ("tasks"."intent_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."intent_snapshot" IS NULL) OR ("tasks"."intent_id" IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof("tasks"."intent_snapshot") = 'object' AND "tasks"."intent_snapshot"->>'intent_id' = "tasks"."intent_id"::text)

tasks_schedule_origin.name: tasks_schedule_origin
tasks_schedule_origin.value: "tasks"."schedule_id" IS NULL OR ("tasks"."execution_mode" = 'agent' AND "tasks"."activation" = 'automatic' AND "tasks"."idempotency_key" IS NULL AND "tasks"."intent_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."intent_snapshot" IS NULL AND "tasks"."plan_object_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."move_candidate_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."parent_task_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."retry_of_task_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."supersedes_task_id" IS NULL)

tasks_agent_superseded_shape.name: tasks_agent_superseded_shape
tasks_agent_superseded_shape.value: NOT ("tasks"."execution_mode" = 'agent' AND "tasks"."status" = 'superseded') OR ("tasks"."activation" = 'automatic' AND "tasks"."outcome_code" = 'plan_move_excluded' AND "tasks"."started_at" IS NULL AND "tasks"."intent_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."intent_snapshot" IS NULL AND "tasks"."plan_object_id" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."move_candidate_id" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."retry_of_task_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."supersedes_task_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."schedule_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."session_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."completion" IS NULL AND "tasks"."next_due_at" IS NULL AND "tasks"."next_payload" IS NULL AND "tasks"."next_rationale" IS NULL AND "tasks"."leased_until" IS NULL AND "tasks"."attempts" = 0)
